completion_handover.task: AC-HO-01 Commissioning / Handover / Warranty workspace UI

implementation.api_boundary: Page uses the SupervisionClient facade for create, Workspace WorkItems and their server-provided actions, and server creationCapabilities. It does not calculate readiness, infer rights, or synthesize commands.
implementation.separate_records: Commissioning packages, handover packages, and warranty claims remain separate items and tabs. Commissioning result history retains failed and later passed tests; handover shows exact scope, accepted documents and reservations; warranty shows defect, remedy, reinspection and closeout history.
implementation.profile_references: Creation accepts only exact active scoped Requirement refs from workspace.context.referenceCatalog whose applicability has the required commissioningProfile, handoverProfile, or warrantyPeriod object. The generic default requirementRef is never presented as a profile. Create remains unavailable if the required exact profile is not readable in scope.
implementation.create_payloads: Create forms send the schema-required separate data shapes, exact typed refs, and empty optional reference arrays; server commands and guards determine the next valid actions.
implementation.localization: CompletionLabelKey/completionLabelKeys are exported from apps/web/src/data/completion-workspace.ts. Page accepts labels?: Partial<Record<CompletionLabelKey,string>>. Root maps completion.<key> dictionary labels and global command/state maps.
implementation.accepted_handover_evidence: Submitted document refs and server-accepted document refs are shown in separate sections; submitted scope and server-accepted scope are separate fields.
